review:
Domnitor's Treasure is a medieval 25-line slot with shields as scatter and coin symbols. Scatters trigger free spins, and coins feed a Hold and Win bonus with three jackpot levels.

During free spins, reels 2, 3 and 4 combine into one giant 3x3 symbol, which pays as if nine identical symbols had landed. In the coin bonus, Mini, Major or Mega jackpots are awarded when the corresponding coins appear. Both bonuses can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 2,000x maximum and a 95.24% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 208 spins. It's closely related to God of Wealth Hold And Win, with a different setting.
